This can actually be two separate questions: "How fast does magnetism propagate in a medium?" and "How fast do changes propagate in a magnetic field?". In a medium, magnetism is as fast as the atoms can realign. In a field, propagation occurs at the speed of light.

All observations on electromagnetism apply to what might be considered to be primarily magnetism, e.g. perturbations in the magnetic field are necessarily accompanied by a nonzero electric field, and propagate at the speed of light.
